title: X Downloader - video&gif
summary: Download X/Twitter videos in the background with one click.
description:
Experience a fast, seamless way to save videos and GIFs from X (Twitter), all wrapped in an elegant, modern design.

• 🔓 No login required
Download media without signing in or connecting your X account.  

• ⏬ Background downloads
Keep using your device while downloads continue, with real-time progress shown in the notification bar.  

• 🌐 Built-in X (Twitter) browser
Browse X posts directly inside the app and download videos with a single tap.

• 🔗 Share to download
Simply share a post with the app and start downloading without interrupting your browsing.  

• ✨ Refined Liquid Glass interface
Enjoy smooth animations, polished visuals, and a premium user experience.  

• 🔐 Biometric privacy protection
Use fingerprint or face authentication to keep your downloaded content private.  

• 📥 Download every video in a post
Save all included videos at once and choose the resolution that suits you best.

Effortless, private, and beautifully designed—your perfect X media downloader.
